text:
jordan_cs: FinTrust (enterprise) flagged SIG/CAIQ due 2026-04-05. They attempted the keystore export via portal and received 401s for the export endpoint. Also the sample audit logs we uploaded don't show retention metadata they expect. Billing noticed a 3x token/usage spike during the repro window. Ticket FT-4892. Can we triage and request a due-date extension?

marie_support: Can you paste the exact error body (no API keys) and the time window we should look at?

jordan_cs: error snippet from customer (redacted):
```
{"error":"Unauthorized","code":401,"message":"missing token scope: ms:export:keystore"}
```
Time window: 2026-03-28T09:12:10Z -> 2026-03-28T09:26:40Z.

alex_infra: 401 + that message usually means a scope mismatch or using a client-side short-lived token without the export scope. Also see a lot of retries in billing spike — likely client retry loop. Ask them for the request trace_id and sample request headers (without secrets).

jordan_cs: Trace ID they sent: trace-0x9ab3. Pasting minimal log lines below (redacted IPs and tokens):
```
2026-03-28T09:12:11Z request_id=trace-0x9ab3 POST /api/v1/keystore/export 401 ms=28
2026-03-28T09:12:12Z request_id=trace-0x9ab3 POST /api/v1/keystore/export 401 ms=26
2026-03-28T09:12:15Z request_id=trace-0x9ab3 POST /api/v1/keystore/export 200 ms=1200 (succeeds on 3rd try)
2026-03-28T09:12:20Z request_id=trace-0x9ab3 POST /api/v1/keystore/export 503 ms=3005
```
Looks like client retried until success then timed out a few times -> explains billing spike.

nisha_security: They also asked for HSM attestation and export proof. Reminder: we never export private keys. For auditor evidence we can provide: (1) signed HSM attestation document, (2) KMS key metadata (policy, key id, key rotation timestamps), (3) audit log entries showing "export-request" events with principal and IP. If their audit bundle is missing retention metadata, that may be an ingestion/tagging issue — I'll check pipeline.

marie_support: Customer asked if we can extend SIG deadline to Fri (they requested more time while we assemble evidence). I propose: (a) confirm extension to Fri, (b) run manual support export to assemble an auditor bundle, (c) redact PII/secret artifacts before sending. @nisha_security can you own redaction and attestation packaging?

nisha_security: Yes. I'll assemble the auditor bundle and include a short memo describing controls and where retention metadata should appear. ETA 48h. I need the policy name used in their request and an approval email from the customer authorizing redaction.

alex_infra: Workaround to avoid client retry billing spike: run internal support export tool (requires support token) instead of letting client loop: `./tools/support_export.sh --customer fint --include audit,kms --start 2026-03-28T09:10 --end 2026-03-28T09:30`. This will fetch logs and KMS metadata without triggering client-facing export endpoints. I'll run it once sec signs off.

marie_support: :thumbsup: I'll reply to FinTrust with the extension, request the headers (no token), request the policy name, and ask for redaction approval. Also flag billing to review retry charges for FT-4892 and INC-1129.

jordan_cs: For engineering repro, here's the curl they used (redacted):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/keystore/export" -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"key_id":"projects/ft/keys/abc123","format":"json"}'
```
Note: token they used was short-lived client token without `ms:export:keystore` scope.

nisha_security: One more ask: confirm the service account / policy name. We saw `ft-support-exporter` but the request principal was `ft-client-app`. That mismatch would explain scope denial.

marie_support: Filed internal incident INC-1129 for audit ingestion tagging and FT-4892 for customer billing & evidence pack. Will update thread when export bundle is ready. Thanks everyone.
